label: Matching supplier prefixes with an untagged stop
definition: At length k record whether k is within the access bound and all k complete lists match the endless prefix. Also record a stop when this matching prefix is reported but a matching prefix of length k+1 is unavailable.
note: A stop omits whether the next complete list failed to match or could not be read. The entire sequence of these pairs is the evidence in the exact-classifier comparison.
